I'm sure a good number of you probably know this but for those of you who don't here's the tip:

!!! Set the option for the torrent to download in sequential order !!!

Not all torrent clients have this feature so you might have to switch in order to get this. I personally use qBittorrent for Windows and Flud for Android and both of these applications have the option to download sequentially. In qBittorrent, this is what it looks like when you're adding a torrent (you can also right click the torrent after you've added it to do the same thing in the context menu). You obviously want to check the download in sequential order box but you'll also want to check the box to download first and last pieces first (sometimes the torrent needs to have the data at the end of the movie for you to play the video on demand). Once you've done this and the movie starts downloading you just need to wait a few seconds before you try to play the movie.

Note: If you want to experience the movie without interruptions you want to make sure the time remaining for the download to finish is less than the length of the movie.

At this point, you should be able to open the movie with a video player and start watching the movie before it has finished downloading. Not all video players are equal though. I can tell you personally that while downloading a movie I've experienced the default video players on Windows 10 (Films & TV, Windows Media Player) didn't want to play the video until it was done. MPC-HC on the other hand works for me.

Sadly, not all files support this. You'll encounter some files which require you to download the whole movie before you can watch them and unfortunately there's no way around this.

I personally use this tip a lot for myself but it's also good when choosing what to watch between family and friends. Hope at least one person can find this tip useful here.
